Must be able to obtain DHS suitability

Turing is one of the world's leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.

We're looking for a high-taste engineer with a strong eye for quality — someone who's worked hands-on with preference data and rubric creation, and knows what separates a good example from a great one. jobs.description:
Archer
is collaborating with BlackRock
to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

About This Role

About this role

Preqin, a part of BlackRock, provides private markets data and technology that complement Aladdin’s whole-portfolio solutions.

The Research Associate combines alternatives research, investor-data stewardship, outreach and AI automation to deliver reliable intelligence across a growing universe of firms. As a Data Custodian
operating under the designated Data Steward, the Associate is responsible for maintaining the coverage, quality and integrity of investor data across an assigned North American universe.

Key Responsibilities

Research investors active in the alternative assets markets using approved public and proprietary sources; maintain investor profiles and interpret developments for clients.
Help build, test and refine approved AI agents, agentic workflows and web-monitoring tools with technology and research colleagues; validate outputs with human oversight.
Build investor relationships through targeted, approved outreach to verify information and capture intelligence on allocations, mandates and organizational changes.
Review and correct data, reconcile conflicting evidence and resolve exceptions under Data Steward standards; document decisions and escalate unresolved risks.
Maintain source provenance and audit-ready records; follow governance, privacy, security and AI-risk standards using approved tools and permitted data.
Collaborate across research, data, product, engineering and client teams to improve workflows, share practices and measure coverage, accuracy, cycle time and rework.

What You’ll Bring To Us

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
4+ years in alternatives, private markets or institutional-investor research, ideally at an LP, GP, private-markets data provider or alternatives-focused firm.
Strong knowledge of the alternative investment market.
Sound analytical judgment, data literacy and commitment to governance; able to reconcile evidence, manage competing priorities and document defensible decisions.
Strong technical literacy with an interest in learning and applying new tools, technologies, and automation techniques to improve research quality, efficiency, and scale.
Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with curiosity and learning agility.

Preferred Experience

Experience with alternative-assets datasets, workflow or data-quality systems, structured data tools or business intelligence, and demonstrable AI/automation improvements with human oversight.

For NY7 - 50 Hudson Yards, New York Only the salary range for this position is USD$110,000.00 - USD$140,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

jobs.description:
Title: Research Technician I

Location: Upper East Side

Org Unit: Matthew King Lab

Work Days: Monday-Friday

Weekly Hours: 35.00

Exemption Status: Non-Exempt

Salary Range: $23.52 - $26.10

As required under NYC Human Rights Law Int 1208-2018 - Salary range for this role when Hired for NYC Offices

Position Summary

Under supervision, assists scientists with laboratory and investigative procedures This role performs various assays, imaging experiments, and other technical duties to assist with the research activities of the laboratory and may be required to work with animal models and/or human subjects

Job Responsibilities

Prepares and maintains detailed records, logs and summary reports of all procedures and results including graphs, scientific calculations, and statistical analysis charting.
May be responsible for tissue & cell culture activities.
May be responsible for animal husbandry, genotyping, surgeries, post-operative care, behavioral testing, sectioning and histology.
May perform routine molecular biology laboratory procedures, such as PCR, protein and DNA electrophoresis, cloning and DNA preparation.
May run routine biochemistry assays including western blotting and RT-PCR.
May perform microscopic imaging analyses.
May be responsible for the receipt, storage, cataloguing and shipment of samples within and between institutions.
Ensures a clean working area and is responsible for washing and storing glassware.
Ensures that safe laboratory practices are followed, including the use and disposal of chemicals and hazardous materials.
Analyzes data using computer software and reports results to the principal investigator(s).
Provides technical support to faculty and staff including training of new employees, residents, postdoctoral associates, fellows and students.

About this role

Preqin, a part of BlackRock, provides private markets data and technology that complement Aladdin’s whole-portfolio solutions.

Research investors active in the alternative assets markets using approved public and proprietary sources; maintain investor profiles and interpret developments for clients.

Collaborate across research, data, product, engineering and client teams to improve workflows, share practices and measure coverage, accuracy, cycle time and rework.

Operate and monitor chemical production equipment to manufacture chemical intermediates and final compounds. Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and batch records to ensure accurate and consistent production
Scale-up production of organic chemistry intermediates and purification using automated preparative liquid-chromatography (prep-LC), ion exchange chromatography, flash chromatography, and rotary evaporation

Assist with routine maintenance of shared laboratory equipment and ensure instruments are up to date with calibration, preventative maintenance, and perform to specifications
Assist with updating and/or writing new SOPs, and present weekly activities at chemistry meetings
Participate in ongoing training to develop technical skills and enhance your understanding of chemical manufacturing processes
Adhere to all safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements, including OSHA and ISO standards, to maintain a safe and compliant working environment
Manage and maintain chemical inventory and support other teams on occasion
Other duties as assigned

Qualifications, Skills, Knowledge & Abilities

MS in Chemistry, with a minimum of 4 years of hands-on industrial experience (or BS with 5 years) in an organic or process chemistry environment
Ability to perform small-molecule organic chemistry reactions and contribute to improving and streamlining production processes
A collaborative team player who communicates well and is eager to contribute within cross-functional teams to support shared goals and drive organizational success
Meticulous and detail oriented, motivated and eager to learn, ability to follow technical procedures with consistent results, and document all work performed
Excellent organizational, communication and time management skills
May be exposed to constant activity that requires intermittent standing, bending, crouching, pushing/pulling, lifting/moving/carrying (up to 50 lbs)
